name: flutter-tools
description: Inspect and test running Flutter apps with Dart/Flutter MCP, and diagnose motion glitches using iOS Simulator recordings and frame analysis.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect Flutter apps and diagnose UI motion
interface.longDescription: Bundle Flutter MCP and Flutter Motion Debugging: connect to a running app, inspect widgets, verify interactions, and capture timed simulator frames for scroll and animation diagnosis. Requires host-provided Dart/Flutter MCP tools; simulator motion capture also requires macOS, Xcode Simulator, and ffmpeg.
defaultPrompt: Use Flutter MCP from Flutter Tools to inspect and test my running Flutter app.
Use Flutter Motion Debugging from Flutter Tools to diagnose a scroll jump in my iOS Simulator app.
